profile.headline: Solutions Engineer | AI systems in production: RAG, agents, integrations | Python, TypeScript, React | 9 yrs in Supply Chain | Forward Deployed & Solutions Engineering
profile.summary:
I build AI systems that get deployed inside real customer environments, then stay there and work.  

Right now that means shipping internal tools and platform integrations as a Solutions Engineer at With Pride HVAC. I built a full stack bid management platform from scratch in React, TypeScript, Node, and PostgreSQL that now serves 20+ users across 80+ active construction projects, replacing a spreadsheet workflow that had outgrown itself. I led the Procore rollout across those same projects, designing the integration workflows and writing the documentation and training that got nontechnical field and office staff actually using it. I also automated our compliance reporting end to end by orchestrating Supabase Edge Functions, PostgreSQL cron jobs, and the SMTP2GO API across systems that were never designed to talk to each other.

Before that I built htsclassify.com, a production RAG application that classifies products against 26,000+ Harmonized Tariff Schedule lines. It vectorizes both the tariff corpus and the user input so matching runs on embeddings rather than keyword lookup, with LangGraph orchestrating the classification agent and confidence based filtering to keep false positives down. It replaced a manual, error prone process for import and export clients. Live at htsclassify.com.  The reason I build this kind of software well is that I spent nine years on the other side of it. At Schneider and Mapcargo I managed enterprise data across carriers, ports, and customs systems, led cross functional teams, and cut operational costs 30% by finding what the data was actually telling us. I know what messy real world enterprise data looks like, what it costs when a system gets it wrong, and why the last mile of any deployment is usually the humans, not the code.

I am looking for Forward Deployed Engineer and Solutions Engineering roles where the job is sitting with the customer, understanding the actual problem, and shipping something that works in their environment rather than in a demo.  

Python, TypeScript, React, Node, PostgreSQL, RAG and vector search, LangGraph, REST API design, AWS (SAA in progress).  Open to travel and onsite deployment. Based in the NYC metro area.
